title: Pair a Bluetooth keyboard with bluetoothctl
summary: Use the bluetoothctl tool to find, pair, and connect a Bluetooth keyboard. This is a one-time setup process that allows the keyboard to work with your computer.
prerequisites: A wired keyboard or SSH access to the computer
Bluetooth controller recognized by the system

steps.explain: Start the Bluetooth control utility as root.
Set the agent to handle keyboard pairing specifically.
Make the current agent the default one.
Enable pairing mode on the local controller.
Put your physical keyboard into discoverable/pairing mode (check its manual, often a button or key combo).
Start scanning for nearby Bluetooth devices.
Wait for the keyboard's MAC address to appear in the output, then pair with it.

placeholders.name: KEYBOARD_MAC

steps.explain: Mark the keyboard as trusted so it can connect automatically.
